title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #11

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   D. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   D. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   D. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Milad un-Nabi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic alphabet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. B — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Milad un-Nabi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Arabic alphabet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
